snippet.title: Trailer 3  Catastrophe - Earthquake
snippet.description:
Released on Friday, April 18, 2025!
In Catastrophe - Earthquake, you control Phe, who, during a visit to her brother, becomes trapped in a condemned building. What was supposed to be a family gathering turns into a desperate fight for survival.
Join the fight for survival!
Join the fight for survival in Catastrophe - Earthquake and see if you can escape the collapsing building!
